features.quote: Loop Limit (Max_Tries): 12 iterations. (Empirical testing shows spirals usually initiate between turn 6 and 10... Beyond 12, context costs degrade the KPI).

features.quote: Do not run all 12 iterations blindly. Implement a lightweight local regex check... If matched, trigger the Judge API early. This saves compute and drastically improves your Trigger Rate per Dollar.
